easy: Easily scared and jumpy, especially a horse.

ex.en: The spooky horse jumped at every little noise.
ex.ko: 겁 많은 말은 작은 소리에도 깜짝 놀라 뛰었다.

easy: Moving quietly and carefully so no one notices you.

ex.en: The cat crept toward the bird with great stealth.
ex.ko: 고양이가 아주 살금살금 새에게 다가갔다.

easy: To show something on TV.

ex.en: The championship game was televised across the country.
ex.ko: 결승전이 전국에 텔레비전으로 방송되었다.

easy: Third in order.

ex.en: Fixing the paint was a tertiary job after the roof and walls.
ex.ko: 페인트 손질은 지붕과 벽 다음 세 번째 일이었다.

easy: Having to do with the thyroid, a gland in the neck.

ex.en: Grandma takes pills for a thyroid problem.
ex.ko: 할머니는 갑상선 문제로 약을 드신다.

easy: A small gland in the front of your neck that helps control how your body uses energy.

ex.en: The doctor felt my thyroid by touching my neck.
ex.ko: 의사가 내 목을 만져 갑상선을 진찰했다.

easy: A written paper where you agree to give up a right, like a permission form.

ex.en: Mom signed a waiver before I went rock climbing.
ex.ko: 암벽 등반 전에 엄마가 동의서에 서명하셨다.

easy: An eye disease in older people that makes the center of what they see blurry.

ex.en: Grandpa has AMD, so he uses a magnifying glass to read.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 노인성 황반변성이 있어서 돋보기로 글을 읽으신다.

easy: A part of the US Air Force made of part-time members who help in war and emergencies.

ex.en: The ANG flew supplies to the flooded town.
ex.ko: 공군 주방위군이 홍수 난 마을에 물자를 날랐다.

easy: An attack by dropping bombs from planes.

ex.en: The old city was damaged by bombing in the war.
ex.ko: 그 옛 도시는 전쟁 중 폭격으로 피해를 입었다.

easy: When a body part or group is not working the way it should.

ex.en: The doctor found a dysfunction in the heart valve.
ex.ko: 의사는 심장 판막에 기능 장애를 발견했다.

easy: To cut letters or pictures into a hard surface.

ex.en: They engraved my name on the trophy.
ex.ko: 트로피에 내 이름을 새겨 주었다.

easy: Making something richer, fuller, or better.

ex.en: The art club gives students enrichment after school.
ex.ko: 미술 동아리는 방과 후에 학생들의 경험을 풍부하게 해 준다.

easy: An officer who works for the national (federal) government, like the FBI.

ex.en: In the movie, the Feds raided the hideout.
ex.ko: 영화에서 연방 수사관들이 은신처를 급습했다.

easy: At or near the front of a ship.

ex.en: The fore deck was wet from the waves.
ex.ko: 앞쪽 갑판이 파도에 젖어 있었다.

easy: The front part of a ship or plane.

ex.en: He pointed the bow of the boat toward the finish line.
ex.ko: 그는 뱃머리를 결승선 쪽으로 돌렸다.

easy: Toward the front of a ship or plane.

ex.en: The captain went fore to check the instruments.
ex.ko: 선장은 계기를 확인하러 앞쪽으로 갔다.

easy: Tough and not easily moved by feelings.

ex.en: Even the hardened sailor cried at the sad song.
ex.ko: 냉정한 선원조차 슬픈 노래에 눈물을 흘렸다.

easy: When everyone must stay inside and doors are locked to stay safe or keep control.

ex.en: The prison was put on lockdown after the fight.
ex.ko: 싸움이 난 뒤 교도소가 봉쇄되었다.

easy: A poisonous chemical in tobacco that makes it hard to stop smoking.

ex.en: Nicotine makes it very hard for people to quit smoking.
ex.ko: 니코틴 때문에 사람들은 담배를 끊기가 매우 어렵다.

easy: Having to do with the languages of Scandinavia, like Norwegian and Swedish.

ex.en: Swedish and Danish are Nordic languages.
ex.ko: 스웨덴어와 덴마크어는 북유럽 언어다.

easy: The family of languages spoken in Scandinavia and Iceland.

ex.en: Old Norse was the language of the Vikings.
ex.ko: 고대 노르드어는 바이킹의 언어였다.

easy: To think something is better or more important than it really is.

ex.en: I think that movie is overrated; it was boring.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 과대평가된 것 같아, 지루했어.

easy: A huge unit of computer storage: 1,000 terabytes.

ex.en: The company stores petabytes of videos.
ex.ko: 그 회사는 페타바이트 단위의 동영상을 저장한다.

easy: Taking over a ship or plane by force on the sea or in the air.

ex.en: The navy fights piracy near the coast.
ex.ko: 해군은 해안 근처의 해적질에 맞서 싸운다.

easy: A small group of soldiers led by a lieutenant.

ex.en: The platoon marched across the field.
ex.ko: 소대가 들판을 가로질러 행진했다.

easy: Treating people unfairly because they are a boy or a girl.

ex.en: Saying girls can't be scientists is sexism.
ex.ko: 여자는 과학자가 될 수 없다고 말하는 것은 성차별이다.

easy: Badly hurt or suffering, especially from a disease.

ex.en: The town was stricken with the flu.
ex.ko: 마을이 독감에 시달렸다.

easy: A United Nations council that watched over lands being prepared to govern themselves.

ex.en: The Trusteeship Council helped islands become independent.
ex.ko: 신탁 통치 이사회는 섬들이 독립하도록 도왔다.

easy: A final, total defeat.

ex.en: The champion finally met his Waterloo in the last round.
ex.ko: 챔피언은 마지막 판에서 결국 참패를 당했다.

easy: A chemical in cells that stores and gives energy.

ex.en: Your muscles use ATP for energy when you run.
ex.ko: 달릴 때 근육은 ATP를 에너지로 쓴다.

easy: A strong alcohol drink made from wine or fruit juice; only for adults.

ex.en: Brandy is a strong drink only grown-ups may have.
ex.ko: 브랜디는 어른만 마실 수 있는 독한 술이다.

easy: Believing things that are clearly not true.

ex.en: The villain was delusional and thought he was king of the world.
ex.ko: 그 악당은 자기가 세계의 왕이라는 망상에 빠져 있었다.

easy: A person forced to leave their home or country.

ex.en: After the war, many DPs looked for new homes.
ex.ko: 전쟁 후 많은 난민이 새 보금자리를 찾았다.

easy: Exciting, fancy beauty or charm.

ex.en: The glamour of Hollywood amazed the young actor.
ex.ko: 할리우드의 화려함이 젊은 배우를 놀라게 했다.

easy: To make something seem bigger or more than it really is.

ex.en: He inflated the story and said the fish was huge.
ex.ko: 그는 이야기를 부풀려서 물고기가 엄청 컸다고 했다.

easy: In a very big way.

ex.en: The video became massively popular overnight.
ex.ko: 그 영상은 하룻밤 사이에 엄청나게 인기를 끌었다.

easy: To help two sides who disagree find an agreement.

ex.en: The teacher mediated when two friends argued.
ex.ko: 두 친구가 다투자 선생님이 중재하셨다.

easy: Having to do with a period of a thousand years.

ex.en: The town held a millennial celebration for its 1,000th birthday.
ex.ko: 그 마을은 천 년을 맞아 기념행사를 열었다.

easy: Being kept down and controlled by force.

ex.en: The people suffered years of repression under the cruel king.
ex.ko: 사람들은 잔인한 왕 밑에서 여러 해 동안 억압을 받았다.

easy: A fight where people shoot guns at each other.

ex.en: The old western movie ended with a shootout.
ex.ko: 그 옛날 서부 영화는 총격전으로 끝났다.

easy: The 18th letter of the Greek alphabet, written Σ or σ.

ex.en: In math, a big sigma means 'add them all up.'
ex.ko: 수학에서 큰 시그마는 '모두 더하라'는 뜻이다.

easy: To go under the surface of water.

ex.en: The submarine submerged below the waves.
ex.ko: 잠수함이 파도 아래로 잠수했다.

easy: A large group of criminals working together.

ex.en: Police broke up the crime syndicate.
ex.ko: 경찰이 범죄 조직을 소탕했다.
